# Committee of two: contrasting agents for root-cause analysis and planning

Selected by Skill Harbor — short listing (the repo states no license, so no content is reproduced): @getpaseo's committee skill — when stuck, looping, tunnel-visioning, or facing a hard planning problem, form a committee of two high-reasoning agents from contrasting profiles (preferably different provider families, selected after reading the configured profiles and their notes via list_profiles), give them the same problem-level prompt in parallel, then resolve their disagreements by passing arguments between them until they converge — and report where they diverged and how they resolved it. Hard rules: analysis only (every committee prompt ends with a no-edits suffix — no file edits, no code); trust the finish notification, don't poll or hurry up (models can reason 15–30 minutes). Honest caveats: not standalone — only works inside a Paseo-configured environment (the paseo skill must be read first, and Paseo's provider discovery covers missing profiles); license not stated by the source repo — short listing with a link only, nothing copied.
